name: Light and Dark
_what: Info film for the Light and Dark domain: the Blazeborn, Verists, Umbrals and Veilwrights, their homes, schools, costs, extremes and the two arguments across the line; closes on the Glare and Slowstair landing. Unlocked by any of the four traditions or their home places.

lines: Four peoples live between light and dark.
Dark is an exact mirror of Light.
Every Reach leans harder into its own extreme. The Blaze burns brighter.
The Blazeborn live in a light that has burned their land to glass.
Glasshome has no inside walls. To them, a room nobody can see into is a confession.
Beyond it lies the Blaze, its edge still fusing into glass. It comes a little further every year.
At the Lensward they hold the Blaze back with lenses. It is the only place they learn tact.
The Kindlers tend fire and give it. The Burning find what is false by what burns off first.
The Assayers burn people to learn what they are. It works.
A Blazeborn is always seen, and a truth burned free cannot be put back.
Valen Sunwrack burned the dark out of a whole Reach and called it dawn. He casts no shadow.
Every village his zealots reach loses its curtains, its locks and its secrets.
The Verists live in the Unblinking Stone: no ornament, no comfort, no lies.
Many are gentle. They will still tell you what nobody has told you, on the day you meet.
The Told Ground is a field of stones, each carrying one true sentence somebody could not say in life.
Nobody may remove one. The Verists picnic there.
The Witnesses establish what is so. The Plain live by it.
Verity does not choose whose secret surfaces. You can be right and change nothing.
The Unbending Witness says what is actually there, whatever it costs.
She has never softened a truth, and never once used one as a weapon.
shots._why_20261007: P1: an epic. Named by her title only: the foothills film already has a Seraphine (the High Luminary).

lines: At the Flensing they tell everyone everything and call the ruin honesty.
They are not lying. That is the whole horror of them.
The Umbrals see by other means. Their city, the Underlight, has windows that face only more dark.
Nobody there is hiding. They are home.
At the Harborward they keep what the light would burn. Some of it should not be kept.
They keep it anyway. The alternative is a place that decides.
Ceriad keeps the Harborward. She never asks what you did.
The Harbor hides people. The Quiet Hands move the unseen trade.
Their craft shelters and hides, and loses to anyone who can simply make the room bright.
Past the harbor the dark stops being a home and becomes a doctrine. The Unlit would put out every light in the world.
The Blazeborn believe what survives being seen is what deserved to.
The Umbrals know who that argument has been used against.
In the Hall of Mirrors every truth is a made thing, so the Veilwrights make better ones.
Everyone is scrupulously honest about the fact that they are lying.
The Storytellers find the better story. The Falsewrights build covers that hold.
Their best liars are their best detectors. They know the joinery.
At the Kindly Court they build a truth a person can survive today, until they can bear the real one.
The Verists call it the greatest lie of all.
Illeth, Queen of the Turned Coat, welcomes every guest. None may leave until they have told a true story.
Tell a lie well enough and you may forget it was one.
At the Last Mask no original remains under the masks, and you cannot check.
Falsecraft asks what a person can carry. Verity asks what is so.
Neither has won. Both keep producing people the other saved.
People confess before they are asked. The light is offered as safety, and it does not switch off.
Between the two extremes, refusing both, walks the Deep Lantern. She sees without light.
She holds no side, which is why either extreme starves against her.
Halfway up Slowstair, people from the dark and people from the light share a landing and wait for their eyes.
It is the most honest room in the world.
